Lift Log is a workout tracker I built for my own training and kept refining. It logs a
Push/Pull/Legs/Upper/Lower split, tracks progression week to week, and exports sessions
as plain text or JSON.

### What I did

- Made logging fast: picking a split day copies the previous session's exercises and
  weights as a template and leaves the rep counts blank.
- Wrote the progression logic. It suggests a weight increase when the last session's
  sets all hit eight or more reps, or when estimated one-rep max has climbed, and it
  marks exercises that have stalled across several sessions.
- Kept everything local. Data lives in browser storage with no account or sync, backed
  up through JSON export. The build deploys to GitHub Pages on every push to `main`.
